papers.title_en: Training-Free Hashing-Based Attention via Binary Principal Components
papers.authors: Daohai Yu, Zhanpeng Zeng, Keyu Chen, Wenhao Li, Zhifeng Shen, Luxi Lin, Ruizhi Qiao, Xing Sun, Rongrong Ji
papers.evidence: 免训练的哈希稀疏注意力，用于长上下文LLM的键值缓存
papers.tldr: 长上下文大语言模型在解码阶段需反复处理不断增长的键值缓存，自注意力因此成为主要效率瓶颈。现有稀疏注意力虽减少计算，但往往需要额外训练、依赖昂贵哈希，或导致明显精度下降。本文提出BinaryPC，一种无需训练、数据感知的哈希注意力方法，通过计算任务数据的二进制主成分来构造紧凑哈希码和哈希函数，显式保留数据结构信息。在多个模型家族和长上下文基准上，BinaryPC保持与全注意力相当的精度，同时超越多种稀疏与哈希基准，并在现代GPU上实现较FlashAttention 3.56倍的端到端解码吞吐提升。
papers.abstract_en: Long-context large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, yet self-attention remains a major efficiency bottleneck -- especially during decoding -- due to the necessity of repeatedly processing ever-growing key-value (KV) caches. Existing sparse attention reduce computation by attending to fewer KV pairs, but often suffer from substantial accuracy degradation, require additional training, or rely on expensive hashing. In this work, we present BinaryPC, a training-free, data-aware hashing-based sparse attention for long-context LLMs. BinaryPC constructs compact binary hash codes and corresponding hash function by computing binary principal components of data. Unlike Locality-Sensitive Hashing (LSH) with data-independent random projections or learned non-linear hashing methods, BinaryPC constructs binary codes that explicitly preserve the structural information of data without requiring gradient-based training. Comprehensive experiments across multiple model families and long-context benchmarks show that BinaryPC preserves accuracy relative to full attention while achieving superior performance among sparse and hashing-based baselines. On modern GPUs, BinaryPC improves end-to-end decoding throughput by 3.56$\times$ over the FlashAttention kernel. Our code is available at https://github.com/yudaohai666/BPC.

papers.title_en: Attention, Anomalies! Handling Attention Layers in Unsupervised Federated Outlier Detection
papers.authors: Mihailo Ilić, Miloš Savić, Vladimir Kurbalija, Mirjana Ivanović, Giancarlo Fortino, Dušan Jakovetić
papers.evidence: 记忆增强自编码器中的注意力层处理
papers.tldr: 注意力层虽在集中式记忆增强自编码器中有效，但联邦学习下缺乏专门聚合策略。本文分析MemAE架构细节，提出引导式聚合方法，针对非IID数据与不平衡边缘节点环境，在无监督异常检测中表现更鲁棒，并提升浅层自编码器性能，适配资源受限场景。
papers.abstract_en: Attention layers are the backbone of today's most powerful and impactful models. Models with multi-million and billion parameters rely on contextual knowledge provided by attention layers. However, their use goes well beyond just being the core component of large language models. One particularly interesting application is in Memory Augmented Autoencoders (MemAE), specifically for unsupervised representation learning in outlier detection tasks. It was shown that attention helps these models be more effective in centralized learning scenarios. Our work aims to address the lack of specialized aggregation techniques in Federated Learning (FL) when it comes to MemAE models. In this paper we analyze the intricacies of the architecture behind Memory Augmented Autoencoders, and propose novel, guided approaches to effectively aggregate these models in federated scenarios. We demonstrate our approach on non-IID datasets and show that these novel aggregation schemes are more robust when dealing with numerous edge nodes in environments with unbalanced datasets, specifically for unsupervised anomaly detection scenarios. This approach improves the performance of even very shallow autoencoders, allowing them to be used in resource constrained environments.

papers.title_en: Divisive Normalization Shapes Low-Rank Slow Manifolds for Continuous Working Memory
papers.authors: Zhaotian Gu, Jie Su, Weiwei Wang, Chang Liu, Tianyi Qian, Dahui Wang
papers.evidence: 基于除性归一化的连续工作记忆计算模型，契合计算神经科学主题
papers.tldr: 经典连续吸引子网络脆弱，GRU/LSTM 等循环网络难以稳定学习连续流形，易将状态空间离散化。受皮层除法归一化启发，提出递归除法归一化网络（RDNN），使动态系统收敛到鲁棒高保真慢流形。分析发现其梯度缩放降低有效秩，避免显式低秩优化的病态。消融表明除法归一化对时变输入防止流形破碎至关重要。
papers.abstract_en: The ability to robustly maintain and update continuous variables is a hallmark of working memory. While classical continuous attractor networks suffer from severe fine-tuning fragility, standard artificial recurrent neural networks (RNNs) like GRUs and LSTMs typically fail to stably learn continuous manifolds, instead shattering the state space into discretized point attractors. To bridge this gap, we draw inspiration from divisive normalization, a canonical neural computation widely observed across cortical circuits, and propose the Recurrent Divisive Normalization Network (RDNN), a minimal and algebraically isolated model of dynamic division. Through dynamical systems analysis on canonical working memory tasks, we demonstrate that this biophysical constraint allows the network to converge to robust, high-fidelity slow manifolds. Furthermore, we analyze the gradient dynamics of divisive normalization during Backpropagation Through Time (BPTT), showing that it introduces an activity-dependent local gradient scaling. This scaling dampens parameter updates in highly active regimes, which empirically aligns with a significant self-compression of the network's effective rank, confining the recurrent dynamics to a tight, low-dimensional subspace while avoiding the optimization pathologies associated with explicit low-rank factorization. Finally, ablations demonstrate that while subtractive inhibition can maintain static memories, divisive normalization is mathematically essential to prevent manifold shattering under time-varying inputs. Our findings identify divisive normalization not merely as a biological artifact, but as a critical computational mechanism for learning high-fidelity continuous representations.

papers.title_en: UniHEAR: Unified Heterogeneous-Source Attentive Retrieval for Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering
papers.authors: Ganzhong Luo, Yang Ren, Hanyong Wang, Shuyu Zheng, Menglong Yang
papers.evidence: 面向知识型VQA的统一异构源注意力检索
papers.tldr: 知识型视觉问答需要从外部异构知识源中检索相关实体，但现有检索增强系统仅依赖单一模态，造成单源检索瓶颈，且双塔重排序器忽略检索来源和候选先验，导致过度依赖冗余模态。为此，提出UniHEAR统一轻量级框架，通过构建粗糙检索描述符，引入检索引导的注意力模态门控和熵加权源融合，并采用对比学习与模态保持损失的混合训练，统一实体级和章节级检索。在E-VQA和InfoSeek基准上，Recall@1较最强基线分别提升6.7和1.2，达到新SOTA，同时保持轻量级重排序架构。该工作有效解决了异构源检索中的关键瓶颈，为KB-VQA提供了统一高效的检索方案。
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering (KB-VQA) requires retrieving relevant entity knowledge from external sources to answer visually grounded questions. Existing retrieval-augmented systems suffer from two critical limitations. First, relying on a single retrieval modality creates a Single-Source Retrieval Bottleneck, missing ground-truth entities that are only accessible through complementary sources. Second, dual-tower pointwise rerankers suffer from Retrieval-Source-Blind Reranking, as they overlook retrieval origins and candidate-level retrieval priors, leading to redundant modality reliance. To address these challenges, we propose UniHEAR, a unified lightweight framework for heterogeneous-source entity retrieval and reranking. UniHEAR constructs a Coarse Retrieval Descriptor for each candidate entity, and introduces Retrieval-Guided Attentive Modality Gating to condition modality attention weights on this descriptor, further complemented by Entropy-Weighted Source Fusion of coarse retrieval priors. A hybrid training strategy combining contrastive learning with an auxiliary modality-preserving loss unifies entity-level and section-level retrieval within a single model. Extensive experiments on E-VQA and InfoSeek demonstrate that UniHEAR achieves state-of-the-art retrieval and VQA performance, improving Recall@1 by 6.7 and 1.2 points over the strongest baselines while maintaining a lightweight reranking architecture. Code and model are available at https://github.com/iven-luo/UniHEAR.

papers.title_en: Unified Lookup-Table Inference with Signed-Digit K/V Caches for Ternary LLMs
papers.authors: Ziang Duan, Jiajun Wu, Zetian Chen, Hao Song, Yanwen Deng, Zixuan Shen, Nuobei Xie, Simo Wu, Bolun Wang, Peng Zhou, Chao Wang
papers.evidence: 三值LLM中用有符号数字键值缓存统一查找表注意力推理
papers.tldr: 三元大语言模型以查表方式实现高效投影，但注意力键值缓存仍需高精度引擎处理，造成范式不匹配。本文提出统一查表推理方法，将运行时键值状态组织为缩放多平面带符号数字，由激活派生查找表直接消费，无需在缓存与注意力间物化稠密键值。设计结合在线键值形成、不完整值块的有界处理及共享多流数据路径，利用约束引导搜索选择表示与执行策略，实现质量与效率的权衡。实验证明该方法在缓存容量、模型质量和硬件效率上均表现优异。
papers.abstract_en: Ternary LLMs make their weight-dominated projections compact and efficient, but attention remains a mismatch: its K/V cache is created online and is typically processed by a separate higher-precision engine. Compressing this cache alone does not resolve the mismatch. To execute attention with the same lookup-table machinery as ternary projections, values accumulated in one reduction must retain a compatible representation and scale. This requirement also differs for keys and values during causal decoding, because newly generated values may belong to an unfinished cache block. This work develops a unified lookup-table inference approach for ternary LLMs. It stores runtime K/V states as scaled multi-plane signed digits organized around the reduction structure of attention. The resulting digit planes are consumed directly by activation-derived tables, avoiding dense K/V materialization between cache storage and attention computation. The design combines online K/V formation, bounded handling of incomplete value blocks, and a shared multi-stream datapath for Linear projections and attention. A constraint-guided search selects the representation and execution policy for a target quality--efficiency trade-off. Experiments on native and post-training ternary models validate the approach across cache capacity, model quality, and hardware efficiency.
